shortDescription: DALLAS, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Applied Digital NASDAQ:APLD, a U.S. based AI data center infrastructure company specializing in the design, development, ownership and operation of large-scale, purpose-built campuses serving hyperscale off-takers under long-term contracts, today announced…

children: , a U.S. based AI data center infrastructure company specializing in the design, development, ownership and operation of large-scale, purpose-built campuses serving hyperscale off-takers under long-term contracts, today announced the closing of a $300 million senior secured bridge facility led by a leading global financial institution.

The facility is intended to fund the continued development and construction of Delta Forge 1, the Company’s AI Factory campus in Louisiana, which is backed by a long-term lease with a U.S. based, tier-one investment grade hyperscaler. Applied Digital expects to seek additional financing to fund the completion of construction at that campus.

The bridge facility consists of a $300 million delayed draw term loan with a 364-day maturity, bearing interest at the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (“SOFR”) plus 300 basis points. Draws are subject to meeting certain conditions, including but not limited to construction milestones, regulatory approvals, including state commission approval of electrical rates, lender consents and certain financial covenants. The loan is prepayable at any time without premium and is secured by the assets of the project.
is a U.S. based AI infrastructure company specializing in the design, development, ownership and operation of large-scale, purpose-built AI data center campuses.

Combining the fundamentals of technical real estate with the specialized requirements of digital infrastructure, the Company provides the mission-critical power, advanced liquid cooling and connectivity required to support artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads. Applied Digital’s AI Factory campuses are leased to hyperscale customers under long-term contracts, combining specialized infrastructure assets with predictable, long-term revenue streams.

Through its repeatable approach to design, development and operations, Applied Digital delivers highly engineered infrastructure designed to support the demanding requirements of AI computing at scale.
Find more information at www.applieddigital.com. Follow us on X (formerly Twitter) at @APLDdigital.
